data.summary: The validation of the CR-002 Random-forest PD challenger model was performed against the benchmark CR-001. Discriminatory power is reflected by Gini — train {{m:run_00d117:gini.train}}, Gini — test {{m:run_00d117:gini.test}} and Gini — out-of-time {{m:run_00d117:gini.oot}}. Predictive accuracy is shown by AUC — hold-out {{m:run_00d117:auc.holdout}} and Brier score — hold-out {{m:run_00d117:brier.holdout}}. Calibration is indicated by Predicted × observed — hold-out {{m:run_00d117:calibration_ratio.holdout}} and Observed outcome rate — hold-out {{m:run_00d117:bad_rate.holdout}}. The review identified high‑severity findings {{m:run_00d117:findings.high}}, medium‑severity findings {{m:run_00d117:findings.medium}} and a total of findings {{m:run_00d117:findings.total}}. The overall rating is Requires remediation before continued use
